verdict.rationale: Synctera exposes a very broad API surface (OpenAPI spec, customer/account/card/transfer/ACH/wire/KYC/webhook APIs) that covers the core banking functions, suggesting most operational capability is API-driven. However, the evidence also references dashboard-only workflows (admin access management, case notifications, 'centralized platform' for operational workflows) with no documentation confirming these are also exposed via API, so full UI/API parity is not demonstrated. Missing for 10: explicit statement or evidence that dashboard-only features (admin/team management, case notifications, operational workflow console) are fully API-accessible.
